subject: general
question: Arijit Singh received the Padma Shri in 2025 in which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Art**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Arijit Singh, one of India's most acclaimed playback singers, was awarded the Padma Shri in 2025 for his contributions to the field of **Art**.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth-highest civilian award in India, granted for distinguished contributions across various fields such as art, literature, sports, and social work.
 
• Arijit Singh is renowned for his soulful voice and versatility in singing, contributing significantly to Indian music and Bollywood soundtracks.
 
• His popular songs include "Tum Hi Ho," "Channa Mereya," and "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil," which have earned him widespread recognition and numerous awards.
 
• The recognition underscores his role in elevating Indian music on both national and international platforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• Instituted in 1954, the Padma Awards are among the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• They are categorized into three levels: Padma Vibhushan (highest), Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• Awarded in various disciplines such as art, literature, science, social work, and public affairs.
 
• The awards are announced annually on Republic Day (January 26).
 
 
 
• **Contributions to Art:**
 
 
• Art encompasses various forms like music, dance, painting, sculpture, and cinema.
 
• Artists play a vital role in preserving cultural heritage and fostering creativity.
 
• Recognition through awards like the Padma Shri encourages individuals to excel in their artistic pursuits.
 
 
 
• **Arijit Singh's Impact:**
 
 
• Arijit Singh's music resonates with diverse audiences due to its emotional depth and technical brilliance.
 
• He has received numerous awards including Filmfare Awards and IIFA Awards for Best Playback Singer.
 
• His work spans various genres, from romantic ballads to upbeat tracks, showcasing his versatility.
 
 
 
• **Bollywood Music Industry:**
 
 
• Bollywood music is integral to Indian cinema, often driving its popularity and success.
 
• Playback singers like Arijit Singh play a pivotal role in shaping the musical landscape of films.
 
• The industry has produced globally recognized talent, contributing to India's soft power.
